items.a: A crisis **you never see from outside**, like the **quarter-life crisis** many people in their 20s face.

items.q: Why do young adults feel behind?
items.a: The old milestones are now **unmeetable**, so people feel **late**.

items.q: How much criticism does Dr. K think is projection?
items.a: About **90%**: people dislike something in themselves and **see it in you**.

items.q: What's wrong with 'just stop caring what people think'?
items.a: It swings you to the other extreme; **value feedback** but **don't let it define you**.

items.q: Why can good news disturb your peace?
items.a: Attaching **extra meaning** to it makes you **move the goalposts**.

items.q: What drives behavior more than information?
items.a: **Emotion**, so find an **emotional reason** to change.

items.q: How do you beat ambivalence when starting a habit?
items.a: **Accept the cost up front**: 'this will suck, I'll do it anyway'.

items.q: What do high expectations do to follow-through?
What is Dr. K's best advice?
items.a: Focus more on **what is happening** than on **what you are doing**.
